pairs.evidence: src/lib/personas/templates/__tests__/templateOverlays.test.ts:38 The overlay-glob pin is a raw substring match over the whole file: comments are not stripped and the needle is not scoped to the include entries of the import.meta.glob call. A commented-out pattern or a negation entry ('!…/**/*.de.json', a form the glob already uses at templateOverlays.ts:288) keeps it green while that locale's overlays never load.
